sections.title: Gasha Spots
sections.note: Tick a spot once you've harvested a nut there. A planted seed becomes a tree after 20 kills and bears a nut after 40 (half with the Gasha Ring).

items.name: In front of Mayor Ruul's house
items.howTo: The soft soil right in front of Mayor Ruul's house. Mayor Ruul gives you a Gasha Seed to start with.
items.reward: Gasha Nut with rings of class 1–2

items.name: Above Impa's Refuge
items.howTo: Just north of Impa's Refuge in North Horon.
items.reward: Gasha Nut with rings of class 1–2

items.name: Woods of Winter, by the lake
items.area: Southeast of the first Subrosia portal
items.howTo: Southeast of the first portal to Subrosia; StrategyWiki: just north of the Like Like lair, southeast of the small lake.
items.reward: Gasha Nut with rings of class 1–2

items.name: Holodrum Plain riverside
items.howTo: Along the river northwest of Mrs. Ruul's Villa.
items.reward: Gasha Nut with rings of class 1–3

items.name: Spool Swamp, by the floodgate
items.howTo: South of Poison Moth's Lair, reached through the tunnel from the Floodgate Keeper's House (StrategyWiki: west side, near the floodgate).
items.reward: Gasha Nut with rings of class 1–2

items.name: Spool Swamp, far southwest
items.area: Southwest corner, near the Subrosia portal
items.howTo: The far southwestern corner of Spool Swamp, near the portal to Subrosia.
items.reward: Gasha Nut with rings of class 1–3

items.name: Sunken City, above the waterfalls
items.area: North, by the house above the waterfalls
items.howTo: In the north of Sunken City by the house above the waterfalls. Reach it with Dimitri or the Zora's Flippers.
items.reward: Gasha Nut with rings of class 1–2

items.name: Goron Mountain, southwest corner
items.area: Southwest corner, near the Temple Remains
items.howTo: The southwestern corner of Goron Mountain's base. TourianTourist: reachable once you have the Zora's Flippers, or before Poison Moth's Lair by crossing the Natzu River with Dimitri.
items.reward: Gasha Nut with rings of class 3–5, or the one-time Piece of Heart
items.notes: One of the two best spots in Seasons.

items.name: Mt. Cucco, southwest base
items.area: Southwest corner, east of Goron Mountain's base
items.howTo: In the southwest corner of Mt. Cucco, which you reach by going east from Goron Mountain's base.
items.reward: Gasha Nut with rings of class 1–2

items.name: Island in the Holodrum Plain lake
items.area: Small island in the northern lake
items.howTo: A small island in the northern lake of Holodrum Plain. Swim there with the Zora's Flippers.
items.reward: Gasha Nut with rings of class 1–3

items.name: By Unicorn's Cave
items.howTo: Just west of the entrance to Unicorn's Cave.
items.reward: Gasha Nut with rings of class 2–4, or the one-time Piece of Heart

items.name: Mt. Cucco, behind the Rock Mushrooms
items.howTo: In the northeast of Mt. Cucco, behind Rock Mushrooms you can only pick in autumn (TourianTourist: near the Flying Rooster).
items.reward: Gasha Nut with rings of class 2–4, or the one-time Piece of Heart

items.name: Tarm Ruins, by the Gale Seed tree
items.howTo: Southeast of the Gale Seed tree in the Tarm Ruins, so you can warp there with Gale Seeds.
items.reward: Gasha Nut with rings of class 3–5, or the one-time Piece of Heart
items.notes: One of the two best spots in Seasons. TourianTourist: the endless Like Likes in the Lost Woods are a quick way to rack up kills.

items.name: Samasa Desert, southeast
items.howTo: The southeastern corner of Samasa Desert, above the plateau.
items.reward: Gasha Nut with rings of class 1–3

items.name: Western Coast, below the Graveyard
items.howTo: The far southwest corner of the Western Coast, below the Graveyard.
items.reward: Gasha Nut with rings of class 1–2

items.name: Temple Remains entrance
items.howTo: On the first screen of the Temple Remains when you come in from Holodrum Plain.
items.reward: Gasha Nut with rings of class 1–3
